diagram.title: Circuit diagram
diagram.description: A quantum circuit on {{qubits}} qubits, {{columns}} columns wide. Time runs left to right; each horizontal line is one qubit.

analysis.heading: Probability of each outcome
analysis.summary: How likely each result is if the register were measured now. The small arrow on each bar points along the phase of that amplitude.
analysis.seeded: The same shots every time: this tally is drawn from a fixed seed, so the figure does not change between page loads.

failed.unknown: This circuit could not be simulated here.
failed.too-many-qubits: {{qubits}} qubits is past the {{limit}} this frame can simulate. The diagram above is the whole circuit; open it in the editor to run it.
failed.sampling-too-large: This circuit costs too much to sample inside a frame. Open it in the editor to run it.
failed.invalid-circuit: This circuit could not be read.
failed.measurement-in-analytic-mode: This circuit measures partway through, so it has no single final state.
failed.no-classical-bits: This circuit measures but has no classical register to measure into.
failed.unsupported-operation: This circuit uses an operation the simulator cannot run yet.
failed.worker-unavailable: The simulation could not start in this frame, so only the diagram is shown. Everything on it — the wires, the gates, the counters — is still this circuit.
failed.server-unavailable: The simulation could not start in this frame, so only the diagram is shown.
failed.server-too-large: This circuit is too large to simulate inside a frame.
failed.server-refused: The simulation could not start in this frame, so only the diagram is shown.

failure.no-address: This frame was not given a circuit to show.
failure.bad-link: The circuit in this link could not be read.
failure.unavailable: This circuit is not available to embed.
failure.no-api: This deployment cannot look up saved circuits.
failure.failed: The circuit could not be loaded.

snippet.heading: Embed
snippet.hint: Paste this into a blog post, a slide or course notes. It shows the circuit and its analysis, read only, with no sign-in.
snippet.failed: Copying failed. The markup is selected — press Ctrl+C.
snippet.sandbox: If your site sandboxes frames, allow both allow-scripts and allow-same-origin. With scripts alone the frame stays completely blank: the browser gives the document an opaque origin and then refuses every script it tries to load.
snippet.private: Only public circuits and circuits shared by link can be embedded. Change the visibility above to get the markup.
